title: LLM-mediated mutations emit independently validated completion claims
statement: Every mutating LLM skill SHOULD emit a schema-valid untrusted translation witness, and an independent Inspector-authorized validator SHOULD recompute its registered strategy, red or overlay behavior, authority and scope frames, effects, isolation, expected state, and cleanup into a report-only validation result.
rationale: A green repository state alone does not show that one mutation implemented its task. Per-translation witnesses make claims falsifiable while independent validation prevents the actuator from certifying itself. Warn severity preserves R28's report-only posture.

strategy.rationale: Red-first schema, frame, isolation, and CLI contracts exercise the report-only validator boundary.
